description: This Dart file defines a Flutter StatelessWidget called RideBottomSheet that provides a UI for ride details, fare calculation, payment method selection, and ride request action in a ride-sharing app. It integrates with RideState for state management and references shared theme and constants.

classes.name: RideBottomSheet
classes.description: A Flutter widget representing a bottom sheet for displaying ride details, fare, and requesting a ride, with options to select payment methods.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the RideBottomSheet, consuming RideState and displaying ride info, payment options, and action buttons.

methods.name: _showPaymentMethod
methods.description: Shows a modal bottom sheet for selecting payment methods.

methods.name: _onRequestRide
methods.description: Handles the ride request action, updating ride state, showing confirmation snack bar, and dismissing the bottom sheet.
